run_segmentation_on_images: run object detection and segmentation on a directory of images using a Detectron2 model
run_segmentation_to_zip: run segmentation on images and save all results as checkpoint files inside a compressed zip archive
run_segmentation_with_model: run segmentation inference using a specific trained Detectron2 model from the model zoo on input images
review_RunSegmentationConfig: review the RunSegmentationConfig dataclass that defines model, device, input, and output parameters for segmentation
summarize_main: summarize the main function that loads images, runs Detectron2 inference, and saves prediction results as checkpoint files
